title: Strategic portfolio prioritization & executive readout playbook (Q2 prep)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook and a consolidated slate of artifacts to prepare a concise executive readout for Q2 roadmap alignment with the Board and Exec team. This ticket centralizes prioritization rationale, data-backed tradeoffs, slide artifacts, and an on-call plan for follow-up asks.
background: After the product leadership offsite we surfaced 17 candidate initiatives spanning Serving Runtime, Dedicated, Private, and Console. Execs requested a short, decision-focused readout that highlights tradeoffs, capacity plans, incremental revenue impact, and risk mitigations. Previous QBR packs were either too granular or lacked clear prioritization criteria.
goals: 1) Produce a two-page executive summary for the Q2 readout. 2) Define and score portfolio prioritization criteria aligned to OKRs. 3) Publish a playbook (one-page checklist + timeline) for stakeholders to use for future readouts. 4) Prepare recommended ask(s) and fallback plans for Board questions.
scope: Includes audit of candidate initiatives, creation of prioritization scoring matrix, executive summary slide deck, appendix with one-pagers per initiative, and an annotated Q&A script. Excludes detailed engineering runbooks and full resource hiring plans which will be separate tickets.
stakeholders: Product Leadership (Sofia Ramirez), Engineering Leads (David Kim, Priya Nair), Finance (Lena Ortiz), Sales Strategy (Owen Brooks), CTO (Rajiv Malhotra), Head of Research (Eleanor Chu)
timeline: Week 1: scoring matrix & data collection (Mar 1-7). Week 2: draft executive summary & 5 initiative one-pagers (Mar 8-14). Week 3: review with Exec + iterate (Mar 15-21). Week 4: final board packet + rehearsal (Mar 22-28).
